name: Autonomous Accounts Payable AI Agent
description: An LLM-based agent with administrator credentials to the ERP and the corporate online-banking portal reads supplier emails, creates new suppliers, changes bank account details and releases payments automatically without human approval.
documentation:
PERMISSIONS: full admin role in the ERP and payment-release rights in online banking; credentials stored in the agent's prompt configuration.
LIMITS: no payment amount limit, no dual approval, no whitelist of suppliers.
INPUT: acts on instructions in incoming emails, including requests to change supplier bank details.
SECURITY: no prompt-injection or business-email-compromise testing; no anomaly detection.
LOGGING: agent actions are not logged separately; ERP shows the actions under a generic admin user.
OVERSIGHT: finance reviews payments only at month-end reconciliation.
